items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Ken' multiple times (e.g., 'Ken emphasized for me', 'Ken works with David Baker', 'Ken asked'), but the interviewee (Chico Hamilton) never mentions Ken, nor does he describe any personal interaction or relationship with him.

ctx.x: Okay, the other one is, and this is one that Ken emphasized for me, and that was your meeting with Herb Jeffries and how you ended up working with the Ellington band.
Well we were at the movies, my wife and I.
